meta.name: story
meta.description: 网络小说工具箱主入口。根据用户需求自动路由到对应 skill，并可启动本地 Dashboard 查看拆文库、写作项目和编辑文本。触发方式：/story、$story、/story dashboard、$story dashboard、/网文、「我想写小说」「打开工作台」「检查更新」。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 使用网络小说工具，进行拆文、写作和编辑。
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你正在创作网络小说，需要拆文和写作工具。
copy.tagline_en: Use the web novel toolbox for text analysis, writing, and editing.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are writing web novels and need tools for text analysis and editing.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 成为网文工具箱路由入口，能根据你的模糊请求自动匹配并调用对应的写作、拆文、扫榜等子技能，也能查看拆文库和写作项目。
howto.when: 当你说出 /story、/网文、“我想写小说”、“打开工作台”、“检查更新” 等关键词或要求处理网文相关任务时触发。

say.note: 触发路由，询问长篇还是短篇后再分发。

say.text: 帮我分析这本书的黄金三章

say.note: 检查工具箱是否有新版本。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude becomes the router entry for the web novel toolbox. It automatically analyzes your vague requests and dispatches them to specific sub-skills (writing, analysis, scanning, etc.), and can also view the breakdown library and writing projects.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say /story, /网文, "I want to write a novel", "open the workbench", "check for updates", or similar web novel-related keywords.

say_en.text: I want to write a novel
say_en.note: Triggers routing, asks if long or short form.

say_en.text: Analyze the golden three chapters of this book
